title: batched drops the last partial batch
body: `batched(iterable, size)` in `streams/chunks.py` yields lists of `size` consecutive items, but silently drops the final batch when it has fewer than `size` items, so records get lost. The last batch must be yielded even if it is shorter (but never an empty batch). `size` smaller than 1 must raise `ValueError` (it is fine if the error only appears when iteration starts). It must keep working on any iterable, including one-shot iterators.
